entry.summary: From a remote Scottish island with just 250 residents to Kentucky's bourbon country, Bardstown Bourbon's Lochs of Jura Finish brings together two distinct whiskey traditions. A bespoke blend of straight bourbon and rye spends an additional 32 months in casks previously used to ma
entry.content:
From a remote Scottish island with just 250 residents to Kentucky's bourbon country, Bardstown Bourbon's Lochs of Jura Finish brings together two distinct whiskey traditions. A bespoke blend of straight bourbon and rye spends an additional 32 months in casks previously used to mature Isle of Jura single malt Scotch. The combination of ex-bourbon and ex-sherry casks adds layers of ripe fruit, toasted oak, and soft malt to the whiskey's caramel and baking spice character. Bottled at 104 proof, it earned 99 points and Best American Whiskey honors at the 2026 International Wine & Spirit Competition.

A dead phone battery doesn't have to mean carrying a bulky power bank and a tangle of cables. The Statik Snap-N-Charge 3.0 delivers portable backup power through a compact magnetic connection that attaches directly to compatible devices. Updated for 2025, the design features a stronger magnet, improved battery performance, and a tighter silicone organizer for its interchangeable charging tips. USB-C, Lightning, and Micro-USB adapters make it compatible with a wide range of phones, tablets, and handheld electronics. Small enough to slip into a pocket and lighter than a tennis ball, it provides convenient emergency power without the usual charging accessories.
